description: This source file contains functions for fitting and estimating electrochemical cell parameters such as diffusion constants, rate constants, and resistance based on voltage cycle data. It includes hierarchical search algorithms, simulation routines for charge/discharge cycles, and output routines for parameter fitting results.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: A subclass of cell that provides additional functions to set parameters and initial states for simulation.

classes.name: XYdata_vv
classes.description: A data structure for storing voltage and temperature data points with associated charge throughput.

classes.name: Model_SPM
classes.description: A structure providing matrices for spatial discretization of solid diffusion PDEs.

classes.name: OCVparam
classes.description: A structure holding parameters related to the Open Circuit Voltage curves.

methods.name: CCCV_fit
methods.description: Simulates a full charge/discharge cycle with specified parameters at reference temperature, returning voltage and temperature profiles.

methods.name: CCCV
methods.description: Performs a simulation of a charge/discharge cycle at specified parameters, throwing errors if unsuccessful.

methods.name: fitDiffusionAndRate
methods.description: Searches over specified parameter spaces to fit diffusion constants, rate constants, and resistance by minimizing error with measured voltage data.

methods.name: hierarchicalCharacterisationFit
methods.description: Performs a hierarchical search to find the best fit parameters by refining the search space iteratively.

methods.name: estimateCharacterisation
methods.description: Main function to estimate cell parameters by fitting to multiple voltage cycle datasets, then outputs results and simulated curves.

methods.name: writeCharacterisationParam
methods.description: Outputs the best fit parameters and error to CSV and console.
